items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: Frankie played the Tramon, I don't know if you read or not, but this was in the band, Frankie Doocy.

ctx.x: So, anyhow, I had those, I got the music, I'd buy a whole lot of music, so, Tingaling, and, let's see, you had the Sheik, I had the Sheik, about right there, I had, well, I had a whole lot of numbers, so they would hire me, because they were too tight to buy music, and I had all the music, you see, so, Frankie played the Tramon, I don't know if you read or not, but this was in the band, Frankie Doocy.
